beaconhold.configuration.area.tooltip: The area of a beacon: a vertical cylinder around the beacon. The functions and the vanilla powers of the beacon use this area.
beaconhold.configuration.blockSpawners.t: On: the function also stops the spawns of the monster spawners and of the trial spawners in its area. The function does not stop the patrols, the raids and the spawns that a player starts.
beaconhold.configuration.cost.tooltip: The cost of the beacon functions.
beaconhold.configuration.dome.tooltip: The energy dome: the visual of the area of an active beacon.
beaconhold.configuration.domeEnabled.too: On: the game shows the area of each active beacon. From far, a faint veil shows the edge of the area. Near the edge, a ring of light with particles shows the edge.
beaconhold.configuration.maxLoadedChunks: The maximum number of chunks that all the beacons of the server load together. A beacon loads the chunks that its area touches. The command /beaconhold chunks limit shows and sets this value.
beaconhold.configuration.radiusLevel1.to: The radius of the area, in blocks, for a pyramid level of 1.
beaconhold.configuration.radiusLevel2.to: The radius of the area, in blocks, for a pyramid level of 2.
beaconhold.configuration.radiusLevel3.to: The radius of the area, in blocks, for a pyramid level of 3.
beaconhold.configuration.radiusLevel4.to: The radius of the area, in blocks, for a pyramid level of 4.
beaconhold.configuration.ticksPerItem.to: The number of ticks for each consumable item of an active function. With 3750 ticks, one stack of 64 items lasts 10 game days.
beaconhold.configuration.title: Beaconhold options
beaconhold.configuration.vanillaPowersUs: On: the vanilla powers of a beacon (Speed, Haste and the others) apply to the players in the area of the beacon. Off: the vanilla powers use the vanilla range.
beaconhold.name: Beaconhold
commands.beaconhold.chunks.limit.get: The beacons load %s chunks. The limit of the server is %s chunks.
commands.beaconhold.chunks.limit.set: The limit of the server is %s chunks now. The beacons load %s chunks.
commands.beaconhold.function.clear: The beacon at %s has no function now.
commands.beaconhold.function.get.active: The beacon at %s has the function %s. The function is active: pyramid level %s, radius %s blocks.
commands.beaconhold.function.get.inactiv: The beacon at %s has the function %s. The function is not active: a block stops the beam, the pyramid is not complete, or the beacon has no consumable.
commands.beaconhold.function.get.none: The beacon at %s has no function.
commands.beaconhold.function.set: The beacon at %s has the function %s now.
commands.beaconhold.function.unknown: There is no beacon function with the id %s.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.beaconhol: More functions for the beacon, and an API so that other mods add functions to the beacon.
screen.beaconhold.functions.chunks.toolt: The beacon loads %s of the %s chunks of its area. All the beacons of the server load %s chunks. The limit of the server is %s chunks.
screen.beaconhold.functions.cost: Cost: 1 consumable item every %s min %s s.
screen.beaconhold.functions.cost.stack: A stack of %s items lasts about %s game days.
screen.beaconhold.functions.none.tooltip: Remove the function of the beacon. The beacon keeps its vanilla powers.
